stem.text: Which statement correctly describes what happens when silicon tetrachloride is added to water?

A.text: The $\text{SiCl}_4$ dissolves to give a neutral solution only.

B.text: The $\text{SiCl}_4$ reacts to give an acidic solution only.

C.text: The $\text{SiCl}_4$ reacts to give a precipitate and an acidic solution.

D.text: The $\text{SiCl}_4$ reacts to give a precipitate and a neutral solution.
